subject: pkg/planner: set proj.AvoidColumnEvaluator in postOptimize (#55333)
summary: Reviewed commit diff vs first parent, scoped to planner. Change removes `LogicalProjection.AvoidColumnEvaluator`, stops threading it through physical plan construction/elimination, and instead sets `PhysicalProjection.AvoidColumnEvaluator = true` in `postOptimize` for projections that are direct children of `PhysicalUnionAll` (`pkg/planner/core/optimizer.go`). This matches `expression.columnEvaluator` behavior (it swaps/modifies input chunks) and ensures the flag is applied after post-physical rewrites (projection elimination / InjectExtraProjection), reducing the chance it’s lost. Added planner test `TestAvoidColumnEvaluatorForProjBelowUnion` asserts only projections under union are marked. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: the `avoidColumnEvaluatorForProjBelowUnion` logic remains unchanged (no later fix indicating a regression).
